name: AI-Research-SKILLs
title_zh: 把 AI 研究全流程打包成可装技能库
tagline_zh: 装完这套技能，Claude Code / Codex / Gemini 直接变身全职 AI 研究员。
tagline_en: Install this skill pack and your Claude Code / Codex / Gemini becomes a full-time AI researcher. No more.
desc_en: Comprehensive open-source library of AI research and engineering skills for any AI model. Package the skills and your claude code/codex/gemini agent will be an AI research agent with full horsepower. Maintained by Orchestra Research.
why_zh: 不是单点技巧，而是覆盖研究全链路的开源技能库。每个技能都针对任意模型设计，装上即用，维护活跃。
why_en: Not a single trick, but an open-source skill library covering the full research pipeline. Each skill is model-agnostic.
limit_zh: 只适用于 AI 研究/工程场景，不含通用办公技能。需配合 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini 等。
limit_en: Only for AI research/engineering workflows, not general office tasks. Requires a skill-loading agent (Claude Code/Codex/Gemini); won't run offline.
